title: Donald Trump controls Resorts International

tellings.quote: For a brief period, he was the guy basically in charge of it for a for a year or so.

plain: A guest who goes by the name JASON tells podcast host Jesse Michels, in an episode about a secret society behind a UFO cover-up, that Donald Trump was in charge of Resorts International, a casino and resort company with ties to the Bahamas. JASON says Trump was basically the man running it for a year or so, which he places in the mid 1970s. He brings it up as one link in the wider web of people and money his story traces.
